review:
Well, the game looks cool, sounds great, and plays like a charm.
Now my problem with the game is this, and i want to give people a disclaimer here: if you play it casually and don't really care much about ranks and stuff, you will have fun. To a point that is.

Started playing this 2 days ago. Reached rank 8 with my modified starter deck. I made a decent mid range german deck with what i found and what i was given by the game + some crafting.

I reached a point where i fight only super duper decks, filled with elite cards (it's the equivalent of legendaries from hs) that you can have only one copy in your deck, and special cards, the ones you can have 2. And the rest full with decent limited and/or standard cards, ones you can have 3 and respectively 4 in your deck. There are decent limited and standard cards for any type of deck in any nation.

The problem is, i reached a level i cannot compete and i feel i can't do shit. Will change this review when devs limit the amount of ELITE and SPECIAL cards you can fit in your deck. 

Why negative review you ask? well, i'm competitive, and i like to be on an even footing with people. And as it stands, the gap will keep increasing to the point people will have 40/40 elite cards into their decks.  A new player will catch up in 2 years or so. Will be forever behind until they have reached the 40/40 elite cards cap. :))

You guys (devs) should put a limit on these cards, like Gwent guys did. Worked pretty good in that one, wouldn't be a problem in this either.

*i know my 40/40 elite cards deck is dumb, i've put that in only for arguments sake. (it's obvious people will put cards that synergyze with their deck archetype)

Update (08/17/2024)

After having  played this game for over 1400 hrs I stopped playing for some time, I came back to see if anything has really changed to make the game better. I want to like this game so much but unfortunately not only did it not become better but it has taken many steps in the wrong direction imho.
The prices are pure insanity for starters ( has to be one of the most expensive games I've seen) showing that the developers don't care about their community much and put money making as a priority. An example why I think this is, and on the topic of cash and pay to win, other games have this too, I want to be honest. BUT they allow you to sell cards you get as doubles for example, BUT here NOOOOOOO , nothing in it for the player. We just want your cash and you GET NOTHING, even after paying a ton of cash to buy card packs only to see useless card doubles you can do nothing with. A TOO BAD, try again mentality.
Very unfair and unbalanced.
Moving on, would like to mention something about the game mechanics which seems a bit off and broken since I last played it. When you get cards delt, they are random (supposedly). 
I have played countless games where I have 1-2 specific cards in my 40 card deck only to see them countless times as one of my opening cards! I have like 15 other cards I would prefer to start and open the game with (and based on statistics I should see them the majority of the time) BUT NOOOOO, I keep seeing these 1-2 cards I dont need as opening cards and the 15 others never show up! Cant make this stuff up. Even the game-play is broken.

Therefor for these reasons I really cannot give this game a positive review, as much as I would like. In the future if things get better and I feel a caring for the community and the game-play gets a bit better I will happily change the review. Have a great day.

Update (10/24/2024)

The mechanics are broke beyond belief and the decks even more scripted then ever after last update.
9 out of 10 players are playing Japan and same cards come out 98% of the time.
Boring beyond belief.
This game is officially dead. Save your money.

Update (03/27/2025)
The game has gotten a bit more interesting after the set of new cards were recently added although some of the game mechanics could be better. The in-game items could be a little cheaper as well.
